summary:
Owners reaping the benefits of a strong market
On April 30, Euronav released its results for the first quarter of 2015. A day earlier, DHT did the same. Both companies produced stellar earnings for the first quarter of the year on the back of solid results for their crude oil tankers, in particular the VLCCs, which make up the majority of these companies' fleets.
